title: Hoshino Ichika — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (So many people from the clubs were doing stuff outside, but it's very quiet in here...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I guess it's natural since it's the middle of summer vacation. Only the people who planned to have club activities and such during this time are here.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (At the same time, it was suddenly decided yesterday that we'd have practice at school today. What led to that exactly?)
Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, there's Ichi!
Over here!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good morning, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, good... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Good morning, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-You're all here...?!
Why?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Guess what today is, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, my birthday?
Wait, no...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Ready, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you all so much...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is this why you told me that we'd be having practice at school today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Correct♪ No one's gonna be here because everyone's on summer vacation! That means we get to throw you a surprise birthday party! Exciting, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree that I wasn't sure what to expect. I saw so many people outside, but hardly anyone inside.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Exactly!
We talked about meeting at a diner or something, but this seemed like the better idea!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, settle down. I get that you're excited, but we still have some things left to do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's time to give you the presents we got you, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Here, this is for you. It's from all of us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Oh, it's a bag with a cute flower pattern on it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hm...? There's something soft inside...
And something hard...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, can you guess what they are?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... The soft thing feels like a yakisoba bun... And the other feels like... A CD?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Well done, Ichika...!
Both answers are correct.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm actually kinda surprised that you got the yakisoba bun right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! That's our Ichi for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: By the way, that CD's by the artist you were talking about who produces a lot of music using VIRTUAL SINGERS.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you remembered. I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I got you a present too, Ichika.
Here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What a beautiful bouquet!
Huh? Wait... There's candy in it?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It's called a candy bouquet.
I remember hearing that you like flowers, so I figured you'd like it if I got you some.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you! They're really cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. There's also... This!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, another yakisoba bun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I thought it'd be fun for you to try out a different one, so I got this one from a different store than where Shiho and the others went. I hope you're okay with it being a little big...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it, Kohane!
I can eat yakisoba buns endlessly, so I'm sure I'll be able to finish it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Next is from us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hoshino.
I got you the hand lotion that I use often.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It also works well for massages, so I hope you get a chance to use it after practice to help your fingers recover.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you! I was just starting to worry about my fingers drying out and not being able to hold my pick properly.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's great!
Haruka and I thought really hard about what to get you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we also looked for some yummy yakisoba buns that we figured you might like!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, what kind?
Could it be from a famous shop?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe. Here you are!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Is this a food model?!
Of a yakisoba bun?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It looks so real!
And it's almost as big as the yakisoba buns I just received! I'm having a hard time telling which is real or fake!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By the way, you can use it as a keychain or stick it to the back of your phone and use it as a phone ring.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was surprised when Minori picked it, but I'm glad to see that you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I had a feeling that she'd like it, but not this much...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. After all, Ichika can't get enough of yakisoba buns.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you all so much.
I promise to cherish all the gifts you've given me today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also promise to really savor all these yakisoba buns.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Great! Oh, wait... Except for the one I gave you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hey, I'm not that desperate.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, Hoshino, do you know when you'll be putting on your next street performance?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Street performance?
I was planning on doing one tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Awesome! Saki and the others were right!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't mind that part.
Anyway, would you mind if we stopped by to watch?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course. So, I'll be at...
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ready, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ichika!
Happy birthday, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku, all of you... Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've finished dividing up the apple pie, everyone. Bone appetite.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Here's your slice, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No fair! Hers looks bigger than the others!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It does? I mean, I guess it should since it's her special day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
We put all the snacks onto plates!
Mind making some room for me, everyone?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I'm not sure we can fit all of these things onto one desk...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, we can just bring another one over. Rin, Len, mind lending me a hand?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line:
Okay♪
Sure.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki and I have something extra for you, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-daa! It's a chocolate name placard! Shiho and I worked really hard on it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, you made this yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we decided to make you something after Honami said that she'd be baking you an apple pie.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see. Does that mean you two also drew these little drawings of me onto the placard?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We did. I drew the one on the left and the one on the right is by Saki. Mine looks a little better by comparison, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Grr... Yes, Shiho, yours looks more like Ichi, but mine's still cuter!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The thought that everyone, including Miku and the others, is here to celebrate my birthday makes me so...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika, have you had a chance to try this yet? It's really yummy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It is? Then, I think I'll give it a taste.
